questions.prompt: The reply has a tool_use block for count_lines. Who runs count_lines?
options: Your program, if it decides to
The API runs it before it replies
Nobody, because tool_use blocks are only text to show
questions.explanation: A tool call is only a request. The model runs nothing; your program reads the request, checks it and decides whether to run the tool.

questions.prompt: Why must your program check the arguments in a tool call?
options: The model predicts the call, so the arguments can miss a field or name a tool that does not exist
The API changes the arguments on the way
Arguments are always sent as numbers
The id is secret and must be removed
questions.explanation: The model writes the call as predicted tokens. It usually fits the schema, but nothing forces it, so the program treats it as a request from outside.

questions.prompt: A reply ends with stop reason tool_use. What does it mean?
options: The reply reached the max_tokens limit
The model finished its final answer
The request had too many tools
The model stopped to wait for your program to run the tool it asked for
questions.explanation: tool_use says the model stopped because it asked for a tool. It needs the result before it can finish.
